acceptance_criteria.requirement: Use a rectangular 35 mm × 25 mm board outline (dimension tolerance 0.1 mm) with two copper layers.
Use J1 with pin 1 SIGNAL_IN and pin 2 GND, and J2 with pin 1 SIGNAL_OUT and pin 2 GND. This is a passive filter for signals between 0 V and 3.3 V.
Connect R1 = 1 kohm from SIGNAL_IN to SIGNAL_OUT and C1 = 100 nF from SIGNAL_OUT to GND. Do not connect SIGNAL_IN directly to SIGNAL_OUT.
Place C1 within 5 mm of J2, measured between footprint centres. Place J1 within 5 mm of the left edge and J2 within 5 mm of the right edge, measured from footprint centres.
Editable schematic and fully placed and routed PCB are supplied with readable entry files and a README documenting component choices and unresolved requirements.
Header pitch, passive packages, component pin mapping, silkscreen, board containment, copper clearance, trace widths, and complete routing satisfy the common prompt requirements.
